description: Make a set of image ads of a product, as the app's Image ads does: each ad a picture of the product drawn whole, with its own headline, second line and button, made from the product's page and the description. This spends the team's credits: the price quote_image_ads gives for the same count, refunded if the set fails. Answers an id at once: call get_image_ads with it about once a minute until its status is ready or failed.

count.description: How many image ads in the set: 3 or 6, 3 by default.

credits.description: The credits quote_image_ads gave for this count; a different figure is refused.

description.description: Describe the image ads: what they show, where, and the point they get across. Left out, they are made from the product's page alone.

idempotency_key.description: Any string unique to this set. Calling again with the same key and the same arguments answers as the first call did and spends nothing more.

product.description: The product's id from read_product, or the product's link.

size.description: The size they are drawn in: 4:5 for a feed, the default; 1:1, square; or 9:16, vertical.

name: make_image_ads
title: Make image ads
